verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS compliance platform like Salv, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The on-premise and private-cloud deployment options are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
